panel.summary: No progress toast during the PPTX image-fetch phase
panel.evidence: `exportPptx` fetches every unique image (Step 2, lines 154-167) before the first `onProgress?.(0, slideTotal, 'slides')` at line 272. Because `updateExportToast` only creates the toast on the first callback, a deck with many images shows no progress toast at all while the (potentially slowest) network phase runs — only the header spinner. The PDF path calls onProgress before its asset resolution comparably; here a `images` phase callback would match the documented 'mirroring the PDF path' claim in pptx-actions.ts:83-85.
